id: title:jose-sequeira:run the parity monitor from the harness stack

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a parity monitoring service to the Rust person identity replication stack, checking Kafka publish topic consistency before reporting readiness.
review.reason: Adds a new Rust crate and its configuration to the CI e2e harness, including checks for publish topics and readiness. P1.F6.H2 adds the monitor configuration structure. P1.F7.H5 adds a compatibility check between monitor and publish configs. P1.F7.H6 and P1.F7.H7 add the monitor binary and its service process entry. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement: the
review.uncertainty: The actual implementation and checks of the parity monitor are not present in the supplied hunks, so the tier is assigned based on the configuration and orchestration changes alone. The benefit relies on the unverified implementation of the monitor's checks.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment requested.

observations.behavior: Adds a new Rust crate, personhog-parity-monitor, to the CI e2e harness and its command-line arguments, and its runtime and readiness checks.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a parity monitor that compares Kafka publish topics against Node ingestion topics, and its readiness and metrics are checked before the harness reports ready.

observations.behavior: Adds a new hunk to the CI workflow, P1.F1.H1, that includes the new crate in the RUST_PERSONHOG_E2E_CRATES list.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds the new crate to the CI workflow, P1.F1.H1, that includes the new crate in the RUST_PERSONHOG_E2E_CRATES list.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a Rust test harness implementation. The supplied hunks show the addition of a 'parity-monitor' service and its configuration, but the chunk does not include the definition of the monitor, the monitor's source code, or the configuration structures. This makes it impossible to distinguish whether this is a substantive implementation of a new capability or merely a test,

observations.behavior: Adds a conditional check and error message requiring the publish topic when a monitor is configured.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks compatibility between the monitor and publish configurations before proceeding.

observations.behavior: Adds the parity-monitor binary to the list of binaries to start if the monitor is configured.
observations.posthog_connection: Includes the monitor executable in the stack startup, alongside publisher and other components.

observations.behavior: Adds a new ServiceProcess entry for the parity-monitor, including environment variables and a URL.
observations.posthog_connection: Spawns the monitor process with specific environment variables and exposes its URL.
